Hi,

Thanks for checking in. There's no tracking number yet, because nothing has left the warehouse on Shop····. Your Harlo B30, Miner Duster and Power Kit all go out together in one box to (address hidden), so there will be a single tracking number for the order.

The B30 ships October 30, 2026. The tracking number is emailed to you automatically the moment the label is printed, so you don't need to do anything in the meantime. It's worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so that mail doesn't land in spam.

If you'd like to follow the incoming batch on its way to our warehouse, you can see it here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support
